steps.note: The milk is brought to renneting temperature.
The starter pre-ripens in the milk before the rennet goes in.
Up to 30 ml of liquid rennet per 100 kg of milk, stirred in for about 5 minutes.
The coagulum is cut when it splits cleanly like glass.

links.name: Tetra Pak Dairy Processing Handbook, ch. Cheese

sources.text: The renneting temperature, starter, rennet dose, coagulation time, cutting and whey draining are from this chapter, which pasteurises the cheese milk (72-73 °C) before these steps.
